decision_rule: An instrument defect is recorded at the instrument, once, and downstream records point at it (H4); it invalidates numbers only where it varies with the contrast reported.

values.defect: run_registers._suffix appends ' Answer with a single word: Yes or No.' unconditionally; 138/140 BINARY item texts in items_grounded.py already end with that instruction. Run-2 BINARY prompts therefore carried the instruction twice on nearly every item (base battery: 81/82 usable items).
values.discovery: found by the claim-blind SITREF builder while replicating the prompt construction; verified against run_registers.py:115-116 and items_grounded item texts.
values.handling: run_srcdec.py reproduces the doubling DELIBERATELY (E3 is a same-measurement replication; changing the prompt would make a null unattributable) and records binary_suffix_doubled_on_n_items; run_sitref.py appends only when absent.
values.impact: constant across arms and doses within each item, so all within-item contrasts (stage 14 signed contrasts, battery decisions) are unaffected; absolute readout levels and ecological validity are affected; cross-item comparisons between the 2 unaffected and 138 affected items are contaminated.
